name: Zacess Yellow on Black
description: Yellow on black for low vision, the reader's Yellow on black theme.
toml:
# the Zacess Yellow on Black theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Yellow on Black"
id = "zacess-yellow-on-black"
description = "Yellow on black for low vision, the reader's Yellow on black theme."
appearance = "dark"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#000000"
foreground = "#ffeb3b"
surface = "#000000"
surface_alt = "#0d0d0d"
muted = "#e6e6e6"
border = "#7a7a7a"
accent = "#ffeb3b"
accent_foreground = "#000000"
link = "#1be4ed"
focus_ring = "#ffeb3b"
cursor = "#ffeb3b"
cursor_text = "#000000"
selection_background = "#09bcc4"
selection_foreground = "#000000"
selection_soft = "#024b4e"
line_highlight = "#262626"
error = "#ffbeb5"
warning = "#ffd8ab"
info = "#a6d2ff"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#ffffff"
control = "#0cedf6"
function = "#88c3ff"
type = "#e5c7ff"
variable = "#ffeb3b"
parameter = "#ffcca3"
property = "#ffffff"
string = "#43f480"
number = "#ffa77e"
comment = "#88c200"
operator = "#ffeb3b"
tag = "#ffffff"
attribute = "#ffffff"
regex = "#ffa1ce"
invalid = "#ffa59d"
added = "#28f74f"
removed = "#ffa59d"
changed = "#ddedff"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#a3a3a3", "#ffa79b", "#01dc3f", "#edb618",
    "#90c1ff", "#fd9cf8", "#1fd3d3", "#d9d9d9",
    "#c8c8c8", "#ffd5ce", "#3cff5d", "#ffda8a",
    "#c9e0ff", "#ffd0fa", "#00f7f5", "#ffffff",
]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-yellow-on-black.toml (Zacess Yellow on Black)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest syntax.comment #88c200 on selection_soft #024b4e: 4.60:1
